articles.summary: U.S. Bank Protect 360 helps clients monitor credit activity, track identity risks and can automatically remove personal information from exposed sites U.S. Bank Protect 360: Key Facts Protect 360 is now available to help clients monitor and take action when credit, identity and privacy risks are found on the dark web. Protect 360 is available within the U.S. Bank Mobile App and online banking experience. The service is available at no additional cost via Protect 360 Essentials, with the option to upgrade to a fee-based Protect 360 Premium subscription to access enhanced protections. As consumers face increasing threats to their identity, privacy and financial information, U.S. Bank today launched Protect 360 1 , a new service that helps simplify how clients monitor credit activity, identify privacy risks and take action when personal information may be exposed, available in two tiers: Essentials at no additional cost or Premium for a monthly fee. articles.summary: New and existing card holders are rewarded for their customer loyalty with premium credit card benefits and exclusive offers. Key Takeaways: Expanded and simplified rewards including 3X per $1 spent on BMW, MINI and BMW Motorrad purchases and eligible gas station, EV charging station purchases and on tollway charges. First use bonus of 10,000 points after $500 spent within 90 days of account opening. 0%* introductory APR on purchases and balance transfers for 12 billing cycles. After that, a variable APR, currently 17.74%-30.74%. No Annual Fee. Accelerated 2X points value for redemption at BMW, MINI and BMW Motorrad dealerships. BMW Card Extend Pay always-on offer of 6 months with no fees or interest for BMW purchases for eligible cardholders. BMW, MINI and BMW Motorrad Auto Sweeps points redemption towards your customer loan or lease payments. Dollar for dollar points system continues for all other purchases. U.S. Bank is launching redesigned BMW, MINI and BMW Motorrad Mastercard®
articles.title: U.S. Bank and BMW Financial Services North America Launch Expanded Benefits, Simplified Rewards for BMW, MINI and BMW Motorrad Card Holders in the U.S.

articles.summary: Contract rates moved higher through August while spot rates retreated from June levels The latest quarterly U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index – Rates Edition showed contract and spot rates following different paths from June through August. Produced in collaboration with DAT Freight Analytics, the report showed contract rates increasing while spot rates moderated from their June level. Dry van rates and volumes Dry van spot rates decreased from $2.38 per mile in June to $2.35 in July and $2.17 in August. Contract rates moved higher during the same period, rising from $2.30 per mile in June to $2.38 in July and $2.39 in August. By August, contract rates carried a premium of roughly $0.22 per mile over spot freight. Fuel costs also played a growing role in overall transportation spending. articles.summary: U.S. Bancorp today announced the redemption on October 26, 2026, of all its outstanding 6.787% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due October 26, 2027 (CUSIP No. 91159HJP6). The redemption price for each of these notes will be equal to 100% of the principal amount of the notes, plus any accrued and unpaid interest thereon to, but excluding, the redemption date of October 26, 2026. U.S. Bank National Association today announced the redemption on October 22, 2026, of all its outstanding 4.507% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due October 22, 2027 (CUSIP No. 90331HPP2) and the redemption on October 22, 2026, of all its outstanding Floating Rate Senior Notes due October 22, 2027 (CUSIP No. 90331HPQ0). The redemption price for each of these notes will be equal to 100% of their principal amount, plus any accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date of October 22, 2026.
